fieldValues.title: Key absence is the sole representation of an unset field
fieldValues.normative_statement: A `FieldAssignment` with `required: true` means its key MUST be present in `fieldValues`. Key absence is the sole representation of an unset field: a value of `null` MUST be rejected — writers MUST omit the key instead. Structural presence and rendering presence (RFC-001 Step 2, where an empty string resolves as absent) remain distinct and MUST NOT be conflated. (RFC-039 [R5]/[R5a])
